title: Intrinsic linking of a simplicial $n$-complex embedded in $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$
summary: We demonstrate the existence of minimal simplicial $n$-complexes which inevitably contain a nonsplittable two-component link formed by an $(n-1)$-sphere and an $n$-sphere in any embedding into $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$. This provides a higher-dimensional generalization of graphs that are not non-separating planar.
